description.zh: 云电脑ID。不指定时，表示查询该地域下所有云电脑。
description.en: The ID of the cloud desktop. If you omit this parameter, the operation returns events for all cloud desktops in the region.

description.zh: 云电脑的IP地址。不指定时，表示查询该地域下所有云电脑的事件。
description.en: The IP address of the cloud desktop. If you omit this parameter, the operation returns events for all cloud desktops in the region.
The name of the cloud desktop.
> This parameter is not in use.

description.zh:
结束时间。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并需要使用UTC+0时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。    
如果不填，则按当前时间。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
If you omit this parameter, the operation uses the current time.

description.zh: 登录用户信息，RAM用户ID或AD用户名。不指定时，表示查询该地域下所有用户的事件。
description.en: The ID of the end user, which can be a RAM user ID or an AD username. If you omit this parameter, the operation returns events for all users in the region.

description.zh: 要查询的事件类型。当EventTypes不为空时，则以EventTypes组合类型为查询过滤条件。当EventTypes为空，且EventType为空，则查询所有事件。
description.en: The event type to query. If EventTypes is specified, this parameter is ignored. If you omit both this parameter and EventTypes, the operation returns all events.

description.zh: 要查询的事件类型组合，可以多个事件组合，查询结果包含所有组合的事件。
description.en: An array of event types to query. The operation returns events that match any of the specified types.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。       
默认值：100。
description.en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page.
Default value: 100.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page of results.

description.zh: 云电脑所属的办公网络ID。不指定时，表示查询该地域下所有办公网络下的用户事件。
description.en: The ID of the office network to which the cloud desktop belongs. If you omit this parameter, the operation returns events for users in all office networks in the region.
The name of the office network.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service.

description.zh:
开始时间。按照[ISO 8601](~~25696~~)标准表示，并需要使用UTC+0时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ。   
如果不填，则按`EndTime`指定的时间往前查询。
description.en:
The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in the [ISO 8601](~~25696~~) standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
If you omit this parameter, the query returns events that occurred before the time specified by `EndTime`.

title.zh: 查询终端用户的操作日志
